question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "shred."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word "shred" means a small thin piece of material that has been cut or torn off. (किसी चीज़ का कटा या फाड़ा हुआ छोटा महीन टुकड़ा; धज्‍जी, कतरन)

 
 
• Example: *His clothes were torn to **shreds**__ by the rose bushes.*

 
 
 
 
 
• The sentence conveys that the most discolored curtain folds are the first to tear and disintegrate, as you have probably noticed at home.
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct paragraph: 

One of the greatest __threats__ to textiles is light. It is a form of energy that can fade colour and cause chemical and physical __degradation__ of textile fibres. Exposure to both, natural and ultra violet light can threaten the __longevity__ of textiles. Light damage occurs progressively. You must have noticed at home that the most faded folds of curtains are the first to __**shred**__ and fall apart. Fading of colours and alterations of hues are the ______ (5) ______ easy-to-detect signs of light damage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Distill: **to make a liquid pure by heating it until it becomes a gas and then collecting the liquid that forms when the gas cools. (द्रव को शुद्घ करने के लिए उसे भाप बनाना और फिर ठंडा करके पुनः द्रव बनाना)
 
• **Desolate: **(used about a place) empty in a way that seems very sad. ((स्‍थान) निर्जन और अवसादपूर्ण)
 
• **Irate: **very angry. (अतिक्रुद्घ, रुष्‍ट)
